name: client-action-authorization
description: An action received from an untrusted client (Remote UI wire input) runs only as a __hypen_dispatch envelope addressed to a live node that itself declares that action; bare names, pre-scoped names and envelopes naming an action the node does not carry are refused

skip.reason: Needs the engine's client entry (route_client_action: JS resolveClientAction / WASI hypen_dispatch_client_action / UniFFI dispatch_client_action) in the shipped artifacts and a dispatchClientAction step in the runner

input.source: Column { Button(text: "Click me", onClick: @actions.handleClick) Button(text: "Pick", onClick: @actions.selectItem) Text("Plain") }

steps.description: A bare action name from a client is refused, even though a handler is registered and a live node binds it
A pre-scoped name from a client is refused
A bare reserved write from a client is refused
An envelope on a live node that declares no action is refused
An envelope on a live node that declares a different action is refused
An envelope on a node id that was never issued is refused
An envelope on the live node that declares the action runs it
The payload of an accepted envelope reaches the handler unchanged
